protocol.hypothesis: Field mean grain yield = intercept + slope * max(field-mean LAI observed by issue date)
freeParameters: slope, nonnegative; ridge alpha=1 fixed before fit
protocol.split: Sort field IDs by SHA256(ghana-canopy-2026-11-11:ID); first 60% train, next 20% calibration, remaining 20% test
protocol.replications: Quadrats remain together and are retained to describe within-field variability
protocol.ambiguity: 7069ZIN has six quadrats and duplicate IDs, excluded from fitting and all accuracy metrics pending resolution
protocol.selection: No test-selected dates or parameters; all issue dates reported separately
protocol.uncertainty: Split conformal absolute residual interval, 90% nominal, calibration fields only; coverage evaluated on test fields
protocol.grain: Reported yield_quadrant is kg/ha per article; reference moisture not stated: no conversion or claim of dry matter
protocol.validationScope: Retrospective 2021 single Ghana area; field holdout, no independent later-season evidence
protocol.operationalScope: A nowcast/assimilation from observed LAI, not preseason yield, fertilizer advice or irrigation causal effect
protocol.missing: No known sowing dates, daily management, independent soil NPK or reference grain moisture
